blocks.text: ¹³C NMR spectrum ¹H NMR se simple (saada) hota hai: is ki har peak (signal) carbon atom ke aik alag environment ya qism ko represent karti (dikhati) hai. Har peak ki chemical shift us ke environment ka pata deti hai.

blocks.latex: \text{The number of peaks} = \text{The number of different carbon environments}
blocks.text_alt: The number of peaks = The number of different carbon environments

blocks.text: Ethane ke ¹³C NMR spectrum mein sirf aik peak aati hai, kyunke dono carbon atoms ka environment aik hai. Propane, CH₃ – CH₂ – CH₃, mein carbon ke do qism ke environments hain: kinare wale do -CH₃ carbons ka environment aik hai aur beech wale -CH₂- carbon ka alag. Is liye propane ke ¹³C NMR spectrum mein do peaks hain, aik methyl carbons ki aur doosri -CH₂- carbon ki. Isi tarah ethanol (CH₃–CH₂–OH) ke ¹³C spectrum mein bhi do peaks aati hain, kyunke is mein do qism ke environments hain (Figure 30.7).

blocks.alt: 13C NMR spectrum, ppm scale 60 se 0: taqreeban 57 ppm par green line, taqreeban 18 ppm par pink line, aur 0 par TMS. Inset mein ethanol ka displayed formula HO-C-C-H: OH ke saath wala carbon green, doosra pink.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.7: Ethanol ka 13C NMR spectrum (kitab mein 'Figure 30.3' chhapa; hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Green carbon OH ke saath hai, is liye taqreeban 57 ppm par aata hai; pink CH₃ carbon taqreeban 18 ppm par. Do carbon environments, is liye do lines.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is figure ke neeche ghalti se 'Figure 30.3' chhapa hai; text isay Figure 30.7 kehta hai. Is liye yahan Figure 30.7 likha hai.
Table 30.3 ki madad se ethanol ka ¹³C NMR spectrum dekhein to saaf hai ke 18 ppm wali peak -CH₃ carbon ki hai aur taqreeban 57 ppm wali peak -CH₂- carbon (jo oxygen se jura hai) ki.

¹H NMR aur ¹³C NMR spectra mein do ahem farq hain. Pehla: ¹³C NMR mein peak ka relative (nisbati) area aam taur par carbon atoms ke number ke proportional nahi hota, jab ke ¹H NMR mein peak ka area protons ka number batata hai. Doosra: ¹³C peaks split nahi hotin, is liye vertical lines (seedhi khari lakeeron) ki tarah nazar aati hain. Kitab ke mutabiq isi wajah se ¹³C NMR technique ¹H NMR se less sensitive (kam hassas) hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Less sensitive hone ki aik bari wajah yeh bhi hai ke natural (qudrati) carbon mein sirf taqreeban 1.1% atoms ¹³C hote hain; baqi ¹²C hain jo signal nahi dete.

blocks.prompt: a) Butane ke ¹³C NMR spectrum mein kitne signals aayenge? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Do: CH₃-CH₂-CH₂-CH₃ dono taraf se aik jaisa hai, is liye dono CH₃ carbons barabar aur dono CH₂ carbons barabar hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Butan-2-ol ka ¹³C NMR spectrum predict karein.
blocks.explanation: Chaar peaks, CH₃-CH(OH)-CH₂-CH₃ ke har carbon ki aik: C–O carbon 50 – 70 ppm (taqreeban 69) aur teen alkyl carbons 0 – 50 ppm (taqreeban 32, 23 aur 10).

blocks.prompt: c) Propanoic acid ke carbon atoms ki chemical shifts predict karein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂COOH ki teen peaks: COOH carbon 160 – 185 ppm; carboxyl ke saath CH₂ Table 30.3 ki 30 – 65 ppm range mein (asal mein taqreeban 28 ppm); CH₃ 0 – 50 ppm (taqreeban 9 ppm).

items: ¹³C peaks ka number = carbon environments ka number.
¹³C peaks split nahi hotin aur un ka area carbons ka number nahi batata.
Ethanol: CH₃ 18 ppm, CH₂ taqreeban 57 ppm.
